full_name: Daniel L. Chen | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2024–2025 Social Sciences Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Toulouse School of Economics (France)
bio: Daniel L. Chen—director of research at CNRS, professor at the Toulouse School of Economics, and moral AI cochair at ANITI—specializes in law, economics, and data science to uncover patterns in human behavior and legal decision-making.
